description: One reviewer's findings on one commit of an agent's pull request (docs/proposals/self-maintaining.md).

summary.description: One paragraph: what the change does and the reviewer's overall view.

findings.description: At most 12. From round 2, every earlier finding again, with its status.

id.description: NAME-N: the reviewer's name from context/round.json, a dash and a number kept across rounds.

file.description: Path in the repository, or empty for the change as a whole.

line.description: Line in the new version of the file, or 0.

body.description: What is wrong, why it matters and what would fix it.
